fact: The HAPDP president says the authority was mandated by its Burkinabe and Malian peer authorities in the AES framework to present a draft text on the regulation of artificial intelligence; the document gives no date for the mandate, so the published date is used.
system: projet de textes sur la réglementation de l'intelligence artificielle

fact: Jurist Abdou Malam Garba said Niger has no specific AI framework, but Law 2022-59 specifically obliges AI developers, makers and service providers operating in Niger to declare to the HAPDP.

Law 2022-59 on personal data protection, in the HAPDP's consolidated text of April 2026, defines artificial intelligence in article 57, requires AI developers, makers and service providers to comply with the law and obliges those operating from Niger to declare to the HAPDP; article 52 requires that a person be told the criteria and data behind a processing that uses AI. The consolidated text's date is used.
